title: Gideon and the Asset
author: Rosalind Oyelaran
blurb: Zephyrine Almeida, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
